FluidR3 General MIDI instrument samples (FluidR3_GM.sf2 by Frank Wen and contributors),
rendered to MP3 by Benjamin Gleitzman: https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts
Released under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 license:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/
Doodle Studio 3D bundles a subset (every third semitone, octaves 1-7) and resamples between them.
